releaseNotes:
What's new in 0.0.78

- Instant notifications: you now get alerts within seconds instead of waiting up to 15 minutes.
- Account alerts: banned, frozen, paused, active again, extended, ending soon and ended.
- Referral alerts: new referral and new commission.
- Withdrawal alerts: pending, paid and rejected.
- Starts by itself after you log in, after a restart and after an update.
- A small "Live notifications are on" notice stays in your notification bar. This is normal and keeps alerts instant.
- Tip: allow notifications and turn off battery optimization for this app so alerts keep coming while the screen is off.
